title: Length-Unbiased Sequence Policy Optimization: Revealing and Controlling Response Length Variation in RLVR

bias_targets.methodology: Mathematical gradient analysis of the objective functions in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) algorithms (specifically GRPO and GSPO) and empirical evaluation by tracking the average generated response lengths during model training to observe length collapse or disproportionate weighting.
